# T-REX assets

Approximately 52 GB of unmodified checkpoints and seven primary benchmark target structures used
by the T-REX controller. Files are portable copies, not links to private storage.
Python environments, backend software, executables and credentials are not included.

- [SETUP.md](SETUP.md): verify the download and connect it to a T-REX checkout.
- [VERSIONS.json](VERSIONS.json): checkpoint/source revisions and environment validation status.
- [CITATIONS.md](CITATIONS.md): official repositories and research references.
- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): licenses and required attribution.

The collection includes Complexa, AF2, PyTorch ProteinMPNN, BindCraft's packaged
ColabDesign weights, BoltzGen, and the full Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 snapshot. The targets
are BetV1, CbAgo, CD45, human HER2, SC2RBD, IL7RA and PD-L1.
They comprise all seven primary benchmark targets.

From this asset folder, check file integrity with:

```bash
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
```

From the T-REX code checkout, use `scripts/manage_assets.py` for verified downloads,
ZIP import and path setup. The public Google Drive link and release ZIP hash are
recorded in the code repository. Pinned upstream URLs also work. Keep this metadata
and all component licenses with the files.

Use the dependency-compatible serving, Complexa, BindCraft and BoltzGen profiles
in `setup/`, together with the matching T-REX checkout's installation guide.
File verification is separate from installation, inference and benchmark
reproduction. See `SETUP.md` and `VERSIONS.json` for prerequisites and validation scope.
PyRosetta and all backend environments must be installed separately under their
upstream terms; they are not redistributed here.

# Set up T-REX assets

Use a matching T-REX source checkout and Python 3.10–3.12. The asset folder must
remain accessible on compute nodes after setup. Allow at least 110 GB for the
ZIP and extracted files, plus software environments and campaign outputs.

## 1. Install the controller and backend source

Use sibling directories named `T-REX/` (code) and `T-REX-assets/` (this bundle),
or replace `../T-REX-assets` in the commands with its absolute path. All commands
below run from the **T-REX code checkout**, not from this asset directory.

Follow the checkout's README to create the controller environment, then
`docs/installation.md` to obtain the pinned backend revisions. Git and Git LFS
must work on both login and compute nodes. The serving environment also needs a
compatible NVIDIA driver, CUDA toolkit with `nvcc`, and a C++ compiler.
Keep environments and their base Python interpreters on shared storage.

## 2. Verify and connect assets

```bash
python scripts/manage_assets.py verify --root ../T-REX-assets
python scripts/manage_assets.py configure \
  --root ../T-REX-assets \
  --complexa-repo ./external/Proteina-Complexa \
  --community-repo ./external/Proteina-Complexa \
  --bindcraft-repo ./external/BindCraft \
  --env-out .env.assets
```

`configure` verifies file hashes, creates checkpoint links and writes `.env.assets`.
It preserves existing identical files and refuses conflicts. The public Complexa
checkout supplies both generation and community-model source; no private checkout
is needed. Software environments and backend-specific configuration are separate.

## 3. Install and check separate environments

Follow the matching checkout's `docs/installation.md` for the complete commands.
This bundle includes copies of the tested installation inputs:

| Environment | Python | Files in `setup/` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen serving | 3.12.13 | `serving_requirements.lock.txt`, `serving_environment.json` |
| Complexa, AF2 and ProteinMPNN | 3.12.13 | `complexa_requirements.lock.txt`, `complexa_environment.json`, `complexa-dependencies.patch` |
| BindCraft | 3.10.20 | `bindcraft_requirements.lock.txt`, `bindcraft-production.patch` |
| BoltzGen | 3.12.13 | `boltzgen_requirements.lock.txt` |

The lock files and patches match the code checkout; profile paths here are
relative to the asset root. Use `uv==0.11.1` and a separate new environment for
each profile. The Complexa setup tool applies the dependency-metadata patch and installs its local
ColabDesign package; the lock alone does not perform those steps. BoltzGen also
requires the pinned backend checkout to be installed separately.

BindCraft requires separately licensed PyRosetta, obtained under its upstream
terms from the official wheel index specified in the installation guide. It is
not bundled here. The pinned checkout supplies DSSP and DAlphaBall; check their
shared-library dependencies on compute nodes. Foldseek and MMseqs2 must also be
installed separately. Configure Complexa's own `.env` and run `complexa init uv`
as documented; T-REX's `.env` is a different file.

The BindCraft lock pins ColabDesign to the recorded Git revision. If using the
upstream conda installer instead, pin ColabDesign as directed in the installation
guide. Check both dependencies and installed weights:

```bash
uv pip check --python .venv-serving/bin/python
uv pip check --python external/Proteina-Complexa/.venv/bin/python
uv pip check --python external/BindCraft/.venv/bin/python
uv pip check --python external/BoltzGen/.venv/bin/python
python scripts/manage_assets.py verify-bindcraft \
  --python external/BindCraft/.venv/bin/python
```

This package contains the ColabDesign `.pkl` weights and small AF2 template array
also retained under `checkpoints/colabdesign_bindcraft/`. They are separate from
the PyTorch `.pt` ProteinMPNN weights. Do not replace one format with the other.
The verifier reads package metadata and hashes files without loading model code.

Run dependency and GPU checks on your installation. Dependency compatibility and
checkpoint loading do not establish a completed molecular campaign. Validation
scope is recorded in `VERSIONS.json`; full BindCraft accepted-design-quota
completion and complete benchmark reproduction remain outside that scope.

## 4. Configure and run

Return to the code checkout's README to set target, available GPU count, campaign
duration and output directory. Complete executable paths and backend configuration,
then run `bash scripts/submit.sh --check` before submitting. This asset ZIP by
itself does not install software or reproduce scientific results.

# Upstream software and citations

Cite T-REX using the code repository's `CITATION.cff`. Also credit the software,
models and data used in your work. The repositories below are official sources;
release-specific commits and model snapshots are recorded in `VERSIONS.json`
and `manifest.json` in the asset collection. A citation does not replace a license.

| Component | Official source | Research reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Proteina-Complexa | [NVIDIA-BioNeMo/Proteina-Complexa](https://github.com/NVIDIA-BioNeMo/Proteina-Complexa) | Didi et al., *Scaling Atomistic Protein Binder Design with Generative Pretraining and Test-Time Compute*, ICLR 2026. [Paper](https://openreview.net/forum?id=qmCpJtFZra) |
| BindCraft | [martinpacesa/BindCraft](https://github.com/martinpacesa/BindCraft) | Pacesa et al., *One-shot design of functional protein binders with BindCraft*, Nature (2025). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09429-6) |
| BoltzGen | [HannesStark/boltzgen](https://github.com/HannesStark/boltzgen) | Stark et al., *BoltzGen: Toward Universal Binder Design* (2025). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.20.689494) |
| AlphaFold2 | [google-deepmind/alphafold](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold) | Jumper et al., *Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold*, Nature (2021). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2) |
| AlphaFold-Multimer | [google-deepmind/alphafold](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold) | Evans et al., *Protein complex prediction with AlphaFold-Multimer* (2021). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.10.04.463034) |
| ProteinMPNN | [dauparas/ProteinMPNN](https://github.com/dauparas/ProteinMPNN) | Dauparas et al., *Robust deep learning-based protein sequence design using ProteinMPNN*, Science (2022). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.add2187) |
| ColabDesign | [sokrypton/ColabDesign](https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabDesign) | Cite the software and the relevant AlphaFold/ProteinMPNN work above. |
| Foldseek | [steineggerlab/foldseek](https://github.com/steineggerlab/foldseek) | van Kempen et al., *Fast and accurate protein structure search with Foldseek*, Nature Biotechnology (2023). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01773-0) |
| MMseqs2 | [soedinglab/MMseqs2](https://github.com/soedinglab/MMseqs2) | Steinegger and Söding, *MMseqs2 enables sensitive protein sequence searching for the analysis of massive data sets*, Nature Biotechnology (2017). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/nbt.3988); for clustering, *Clustering huge protein sequence sets in linear time*, Nature Communications (2018). [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-018-04964-5) |
| Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 | [QwenLM official GitHub organization](https://github.com/QwenLM); [exact model snapshot](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8/tree/ec4160bf26124fa57e6451d070ee0c459a36d5b7) | Qwen Team, *Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model* (2026). [Model release](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.6-27b) |
| vLLM | [vllm-project/vllm](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) | Kwon et al., *Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention*, SOSP (2023). [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180) |

The processed target structures are redistributed from the pinned public
Complexa data tree; individual source URLs and hashes are in the asset manifest,
and attribution is retained in `targets/ATTRIBUTION.txt`. Cite original structure
depositions where applicable. Checkpoint license notices remain beside each model.

# Third-party notices

This collection retains separate upstream licenses. No single T-REX license
is applied to all assets. Files are copied without changing model parameters
or structure coordinates; directory layout and attribution files are added.

| Component | License and source |
| --- | --- |
| Complexa | [NVIDIA Open Model License](checkpoints/complexa/LICENSE); [required Notice](checkpoints/complexa/Notice); [official model card](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NV-Proteina-Complexa-Protein-Target-160M-v1) |
| AF2 parameters | [CC BY 4.0](checkpoints/af2/LICENSE); [attribution](checkpoints/af2/ATTRIBUTION.txt); [upstream terms](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold#model-parameters) |
| ProteinMPNN | [MIT](checkpoints/proteinmpnn/LICENSE); [upstream](https://github.com/dauparas/ProteinMPNN) |
| BindCraft ColabDesign package weights | [ColabDesign Beer-Ware notice](checkpoints/colabdesign_bindcraft/LICENSE.txt); [original ProteinMPNN MIT license](checkpoints/colabdesign_bindcraft/ProteinMPNN-LICENSE); [attribution](checkpoints/colabdesign_bindcraft/ATTRIBUTION.txt); [official source](https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabDesign/tree/e31a56fe1d9b4de25c8697f3a28b75892941cc72) |
| BoltzGen weights | [MIT](checkpoints/boltzgen/LICENSE); [official model card](https://huggingface.co/boltzgen/boltzgen-1) |
| BoltzGen molecule dictionary | MIT as declared in the [pinned dataset card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/boltzgen/inference-data/blob/c3d36fd276e9caf098c75d4113c6d5eb320b1a4c/README.md) |
| Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 | [Apache 2.0](checkpoints/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8/LICENSE); [included model card](checkpoints/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8/README.md); [official model](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8) |
| Processed target structures | [CC BY 4.0](targets/LICENSE), as distributed by Proteina-Complexa; [attribution and exact public source](targets/ATTRIBUTION.txt) |

The manifest pins source revisions, exact paths, sizes and hashes. Retain the
licenses, notices and attribution files when redistributing. Backend software,
PyRosetta and third-party executables are not included in this asset collection.

Official GitHub repositories and research references are listed in [CITATIONS.md](CITATIONS.md).
